items.title: How much does waiting to catch a gap actually cost?
items.description: Sam's bulk-actions gap (from L2/L3) could have been caught in the same conversation, or much later after shipping. This is an illustrative model, not an exact estimate. Drag "Days until the gap is discovered" from 0 (conversation) toward 60 (long after ship) and watch the relative cost climb because more work has been built on top of the unclear requirement.

params.name: daysToDiscovery
params.label: Days until the gap is discovered

items.compute: const multiplier = 1 + Math.pow(params.daysToDiscovery / 5, 1.5); return { costMultiplier: Math.round(multiplier * 10) / 10 };

outputs.label: Relative cost to fix (x the original conversation)
